query: UPDATE assistant_batches SET state='approved',approved_at=coalesce(approved_at,now()),approval_event_sha256=coalesce(approval_event_sha256,$5) WHERE workspace_id=$1 AND user_id=$2 AND login_id=$3 AND id=$4 AND state IN ('proposed','approved') AND expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND (approval_event_sha256 IS NULL OR $5::text IS NULL OR approval_event_sha256=$5)
